name: raspberry-pi-imager-write-os
match: Finish downloading and writing the latest Raspberry Pi OS to the attached SD card
write raspberry pi os to sd card
flash sd card with raspberry pi os
source_task: Finish downloading and writing the latest Raspberry Pi OS to the attached SD card. If administrative permission, device selection, or confirmation is required, prompt me for that input.
leftover: In Raspberry Pi Imager choose OS → {{os}} (e.g., 'Raspberry Pi OS (32-bit, Latest)'), choose target device → {{device}}, click Write and enter admin password if prompted. If the app crashes, force-quit any 'rpi-imager' processes and relaunch. If the SD card isn’t mounted, remove and reinsert the card/reader so it appears in device selection.
